description:
Die-cut business card printing: Out of the box marketing that works.

When standing out matters, die-cut business cards give you an edge that standard shapes can’t match. From rounded corners to bold ovals and leaf shapes, these cards are designed to catch attention and reflect the creativity behind your brand. Ideal for designers, artists, and anyone with a bold visual identity, die-cut cards offer both style and substance in one compact format. 

Custom Shapes Made to Stand Out

Creative Shape Options
Premium Cardstock Choices 
Standard and Custom Sizes
Rounded corners, leaf, oval, half-circle, circle, and slim cards Printed on 14 pt. or 16 pt. cardstock Standard sizes like 2" x 3.5", 2" x 2", and 2.5" circle 
Match your card shape to your logo or brand feel  Silk, soft touch, and antibacterial finishes available Custom dimensions available 
Choose from standard or fully custom shapes  Optional foil or spot UV for added texture and shine Minimum order of 25 cards 

Customise Every Detail of Your Die-Cut Business Cards


Choose Your Shape 

Pick from preset die-cut styles or select “custom” to upload your own unique shape. 

  

Finish It Your Way 

Add soft touch or silk lamination for a refined feel. Highlight details with spot UV or foil accents. 

  

Print on One or Both Sides 

Showcase your logo on one side and contact details on the other—or maximize both sides for visuals.  

  

Use Our Online Design Tool 

Upload a ready-made file or start from scratch using our free online editor with live preview.





Die-Cut Business Cards FAQs

Yes. Choose ‘Custom’ from the shapes options in the order calculator.

You can get your die-cut business cards in ready to ship in 2, 4, and 6 business days. To estimate shipping dates, click the Estimate Shipping & Delivery link and enter your zip code.

The minimum order for business cards is 25 pieces. Although we don’t print sample pieces, you can order our   to see the different materials, textures, and colors that we use on our business cards.

Standard options include rounded corners, oval, leaf, circle, half-circle, and slim card sizes. You can also submit a completely custom shape.

You can choose from matte, gloss, high gloss, silk, or soft touch lamination. Foil stamping and spot UV are also available for added detail.
